([[Tinton Falls, New Jersey]]) | draft_year = 2021 | career_start = 2021 | career_end = | years1 = [[2021–22 NBA G League season|2021–2022]] | team1 = [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] | years2 = [[2022–23 NBA G League season|2022–2023]] | team2 = [[Iowa Wolves]] | years3 = [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023–2024]] | team3 = [[Mexico City Capitanes]] | years4 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team4 = [[Texas Legends]] | years5 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2025]] | team5 = [[Maine Celtics]] | years6 = {{nbay|2024|end}} | team6 = [[Philadelphia 76ers]] | years7 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team7 = [[Osceola Magic]] | years8 = [[2025 Baloncesto Superior Nacional season|2025]]–present | team8 = [[Piratas de Quebradillas]] | highlights = }} '''Phillip Wheeler''' (born April 23, 2002) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Piratas de Quebradillas]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]] (BSN). He has previously played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]]. ==High school career== Wheeler played for his freshman and sophomore years at [[Rumson-Fair Haven Regional High School]] before transferring to the [[Ranney School]] for the 2018–19 school year.{{Cite web |url=https://tworivertimes.com/ranneys-wheeler-leaves-high-school-for-pro-basketball-in-italy/ |access-date=April 1, 2025 |website=tworivertimes.com |title=Ranney's Wheeler Leaves High School for Pro Basketball in Italy - Two River Times |date=August 27, 2019 }} Wheeler decided to sign a contract with [[Stella Azzurra Roma]] instead of returning to play his senior year.{{Cite web |last=Zagoria |first=Adam |date=August 7, 2019 |title=New Jersey forward Phillip Wheeler forgoes senior year in high school to sign in Italy |url=https://www.zagsblog.com/2019/08/07/new-jersey-forward-phillip-wheeler-forgoes-senior-year-in-high-school-to-sign-in-italy/ |access-date=April 1, 2025 |website=Zagsblog |language=en-US}} ==Professional career== ===Stella Azzurra=== Wheeler appeared in 4 games for the Stella Azzurra U18 team at the [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]]. He averaged 8.3 points and 4.3 rebounds in 13.9 minutes.{{Cite web |title=Stella Azzurra U18 Stats - RealGM |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/league/115/Munich-Tournament-ANGT/team/786/Stella-Azzurra-U18/stats/2020/Averages/All/All/points/All/desc/1/Regular_Season |access-date=April 1, 2025 |website=basketball.realgm.com |language=en}} ===Atleticos de San German=== [[Atleticos de San German]] selected Wheeler with the 5th overall pick in the 2020 [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]] draft.{{Cite web |date=January 17, 2020 |title=Georgie Pacheco Es El Número 1 del Sorteo de Nuevo Ingreso del BSN 2020 |url=https://canchalatina.com/2020/01/17/georgie-pacheco-es-el-numero-1-del-sorteo-de-nuevo-ingreso-del-bsn-2020/ |access-date=April 1, 2025 |website=CANCHA LATINA |language=es}} ===Gimnasia y Esgrima de Comodoro Rivadavia=== On January 25, 2021, Wheeler signed with [[Gimnasia y Esgrima de Comodoro Rivadavia]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquetbol]].{{Cite web |title=Gimnasia se refuerza con Pablo Siaan Rojas y Phillip Wheeler |url=https://www.laliganacional.com.ar/laliga/page/noticias/id/32665/title/Gimnasia-se-refuerza-con-Pablo-Siaan-Rojas-y-Phillip-Wheeler |access-date=April 2, 2025 |website=Liga Nacional de Básquetbol |date=January 25, 2021 |language=es}}{{Cite web |title=Latin American basketball News, Scores, Stats, Analysis, Standings |url=https://www.latinbasket.com/Puerto-Rico/news/665600/Phillip-Wheeler-(ex-San-German)-joins-Gimnasia |access-date=April 2, 2025 |website=www.latinbasket.com}} Wheeler continued to play for San German in the summer. ===Rio Grande Valley Vipers=== Later in 2021, Wheeler tried out for the Rio Grande Valley Vipers in the [[NBA G League|NBA G-League]]. Wheeler did not make the team and instead became an unpaid practice player for the Vipers.{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/gtvhoops/p/DD4r_WCxa98/?img_index=2 |access-date=April 2, 2025 |website=www.instagram.com}} The Vipers signed Wheeler on January 24, 2022.{{Cite web |title=NBA G League Transactions |url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions?teams=1612709908&date=All+Dates |access-date=April 2, 2025 |website=The NBA G League |language=en}} Wheeler played sparingly in two games before being waived on the January 31.{{Cite web |title=2021-22 Rio Grande Valley Vipers Stats |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/gleague/teams/RGV/2022.html |access-date=April 2, 2025 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}} Wheeler also came off the bench in four games for the Ciudad de Mexico Capitanes during the 2021 Tip-Off Tournament.{{Cite web |title=2021-22 Ciudad de Mexico Capitanes Stats |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/gleague/teams/MXC/2022.html |access-date=April 2, 2025 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}} ===Philadelphia 76ers=== On March 26, 2025, Wheeler signed a 10-day contract with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] via a hardship exception.{{Cite web|title=Sixers add Phillip Wheeler on 10-day contract through hardship exception|url=https://www.nbcsportsphiladelphia.com/nba/philadelphia-76ers/sixers-sign-phillip-wheeler-10-day-contract-sixers-roster/656999/?amp=1|access-date=May 26, 2025|website=nbcsportsphiladelphia.com| date=March 26, 2025 |language=en}} In his NBA debut that day against the [[2024–25 Washington Wizards season|Washington Wizards]], Wheeler recorded four points and four rebounds.{{Cite web|title=Sixers' Wheeler impresses in NBA debut|url=https://phillysportsnetwork.com/2025/03/28/sixers-wheeler-nba-debut/|access-date=May 26, 2025|website=phillysportsnetwork.com|language=en}} Wheeler's contract expired on April 3.{{Cite web |date=April 5, 2025 |title=Sixers sign Marcus Bagley to second 10-day contract |url=https://www.phillyvoice.com/sixers-news-analysis-marcus-bagley-stats-bio-phillip-wheeler-nba-free-agents-10-day-contracts-daryl-morey/ |access-date=June 9, 2025 |website=PhillyVoice |language=english}} ===Piratas de Quebradillas=== Wheeler joined [[Piratas de Quebradillas]] in April 2025.{{Cite web |title=Piratas de Quebradillas Transactions |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/league/62/Puerto-Rican-BSN/team/161/Piratas-de-Quebradillas/transactions/2025 |access-date=June 9, 2025 |website=basketball.realgm.com |language=en}} He was selected for the BSN All Star Game in June 2025.{{Cite web |date=June 7, 2025 |title=Los D Aquí dominan el Juego de Estrellas del BSN; Víctor Liz se corona MVP |url=https://www.telemundopr.com/historias-destacadas/hoy-juego-de-estrellas-del-bsn-por-telemundo/2723199/ |access-date=June 9, 2025 |website=Telemundo Puerto Rico |language=es}} On July 4, 2025, Wheeler joined the [[2025 NBA Summer League]] [[Indiana Pacers]]' roster.{{cite web|title=Pacers Announce 2025 Summer League Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-announce-2025-summer-league-roster|website=NBA.com|date=July 4, 2025|access-date=July 17, 2025}} Wheeler had a successful run with the Pacers, scoring big numbers in little minutes. On October 13, he signed a training camp contract with the [[Orlando Magic]]. However, Wheeler was waived by the Magic on October 18.{{Cite web|title=Magic waive Reece Beekman, Lester Quiñones, Javonte Smart, and Phillip Wheeler|url=https://www.hoopshype.com/story/sports/nba/rumors/2025/10/18/magic-waive-reece-beekman-lester-quinones-javonte-smart-and-phillip-wheeler/86770440007/|access-date=October 24, 2025|website=hoopshype.com|language=en}} He then joined the [[Osceola Magic]] of the [[NBA G League]]. ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Regular season==== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2024}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2024–25 Philadelphia 76ers season|Philadelphia]] | 5 || 0 || 8.9 || .143 || .000 || 1.000 || 1.6 || .4 || .2 || .4 || 1.6 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 5 || 0 || 8.9 || .143 || .000 || 1.000 || 1.6 || .4 || .2 || .4 || 1.6 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Wheeler, Phillip}} [[Category:2002 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Mexico]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Monmouth County, New Jersey]] [[Category:Iowa Wolves players]] [[Category:Maine Celtics players]] [[Category:Mexico City Capitanes players]] [[Category:Osceola Magic players]] [[Category:Philadelphia 76ers players]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:Ranney School alumni]] [[Category:Rio Grande Valley Vipers players]] [[Category:Rumson-Fair Haven Regional High School alumni]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Rumson, New Jersey]] [[Category:Texas Legends players]] [[Category:Undrafted NBA players]]
